item.title: 【HD Live Performances】WEB-DL - AURORA - 2025-08-22 Rock en Seine, Paris, France (new VOD 1080p CFR + remastered audio)
item.description:
I upped this to Dime also. I you already have a copy, check the audio is true stereo (not the livestream) and the the video is CFR. I want all the VFR versions to disappear as they as not suitable for editing or remastering


AURORA - 2025-08-22 Rock en Seine, Paris, France (new VOD 1080p CFR + remastered audio)

AURORA
Rock en Seine 2025 Festival
Paris
France
new VOD 1080p CFR + remastered audio
re-captured in May 2026
performance on 2025-08-22
August 22, 2025

https://www.france.tv/spectacles-et...7-aurora-en-concert-a-rock-en-seine-2025.html

The artifacted stereo livestream audio may have been rescued by france.tv by using Jusper Lee's Apollo project or code evolved from that project. It's not perfect to an audiophile, but is a massive improvement over the original. Note france.tv served dual mono for quite some time (possibly a safety backup from the soundboard). There's various discussions about the mistake on Reddit and elsewhere.

Multiple folks did stream captures of the new VOD and none were perfect. The stream server appears to misconfigured and is outputing CFR video and tagging it as VFR. I (HAF) and others watched the version posted here and audio-video sync looks fine and appears to be CFR.

Test for VFR vs. CFR:
ffmpeg -i "AURORA - 2025-08-22 Rock en Seine, Paris, France (new VOD 1080p CFR + remastered audio).mkv" -vf vfrdet -f null NUL

"If VFR:0.000000: It is a pure CFR video. None of the frames have varying durations."

The last line of the actual test confirmed this is a pure CFR video, despite france.tv's server issue:
"[Parsed_vfrdet_0 @ 0000000002b39b80] VFR:0.000000 (0/92467)"

The video posted here is Fractal-Infinity's stream capture demuxed and remuxed by HugeAuroraFan with the legacy mkvextract 9.60 and mkvmerge 9.60 that is able to tag it as CFR (don't ask me if this is a bug or feature, I don't know and don't care as the 9.60 video looks, sounds, and tests fine).

Video: H.264 1920x1080p 4996Kbps 25 FPS CFR runtime 01:01:39
Audio: AAC LC 192Kbps 48KHz 2 channel runtime 01:01:39

Lineage: IDM for .m3u8 URLs -> yt-dlp -> mkvmerge 95.0 -> VFR .mkv -> mega -> mkvextract 9.60 -> .avc + .aac -> mkvmerge 9.60 -> .mkv

item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - Bring Me The Horizon - Live at Wembley (Ultra HD Version) [24bit / 48kHz] (BluRay LPCM Audio RIP)
item.description:
Artist: Bring Me The Horizon
Album : Live At Wembley
Genre: Metalcore
Format: FLAC (24 bits / 48 kHz) (BluRay LPCM Audio RIP)

1. Intro
2. Shadow Moses
3. Go To Hell,.For Heaven's Sake
4. The House Of Wolves
5. Diamonds Aren't Forever
6. It Never Ends
7. And The Snakes Start To Sing
8. Alligator Blood
9. Empire (Let Them Sing)
10. Chelsea Smile
11. Pray For Plages
12. Blessed With A Curse
13. Antivist
14. Sleepwalking
15. Hospital For Souls
16. Drown
17. Can You Feel My Heart

It took me quite a while, as I had to separate the LPCM audio from the original Blu-ray (fortunately, it was 32-bit/48kHz), transfer it to Audacity, edit its duration, and cut it track by track and, Finally, export it to 24-bit/48kHz FLAC.
But it was worth it! Especially because now all the tracks are connected and there's no longer that disconnect between Empire and Chelsea Smile.

The truth is that the result was extraordinary, with audio clearly superior to that of their CDs.
